name: Quiet Time
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of quietness and stillness as a means of resting in the Lord and meditating on His law. Believers are encouraged to hold their peace and trust in God's protection, as seen in Exodus 14:14, and to delight in His Word day and night, cultivating a heart that communes with God in silence and reflection. The imagery of lying down beside still waters and resting patiently in the Lord underscores the peace and spiritual renewal found in intentional quiet time.
